meta.title: Mila University | Faculties, Programs & Research in Mila, Algeria
meta.description: Mila University in Algeria: explore our faculties, degree programs in science, technology and economics, research laboratories, campus life and upcoming events.

hero.description: Abdelhafid Boussouf University – Mila is a public scientific and cultural institution providing qualitative scientific training to students in various fields, established by Executive Decree No. 08-204 of July 9, 2008.

rector.name: Prof. Amirouche Bouchelaghem
rector.summary: Born in 1964, a university professor specialising in Economics and Health Economics, dedicated to building qualitative scientific environments for researchers and students across Algeria.

platforms.label: Online services
platforms.title: Educational Platforms
platforms.intro: Everything you need for your studies, online: request documents, follow your courses and check your timetable from anywhere.

documents.title: Document Request
documents.description: Request official documents online, including enrolment certificates, transcripts and diplomas, and track each request until it is ready for collection.

elearning.title: E-learning
elearning.description: Reach your courses, lecture notes, videos and assignments on the university's online learning platform, anytime and from any device.

timetables.title: Timetables
timetables.description: Find up-to-date timetables for every faculty, department and specialty in one place, covering lectures, tutorials and exam sessions.

faculties.label: Faculties & Institutes
faculties.title: Faculties and Institutes
faculties.intro: Seven faculties and institutes offering bachelor, master and doctoral programs across sciences, technology, languages, law and economics.

economics.title: Economics, Management and Business Sciences
economics.description: Economic analysis, management, commerce and finance, preparing students for careers in business, banking, entrepreneurship and public administration.

foreignLanguages.title: Letters and Foreign Languages
foreignLanguages.description: Foreign languages, literature and translation, opening doors to teaching, translation and international communication.

arabic.title: Arabic Language and Literature
arabic.description: Arabic language, literature and linguistics, cultivating heritage and critical thinking for careers in teaching, research and media.

natureLife.title: Natural and Life Sciences
natureLife.description: Biology, ecology and environmental sciences, with laboratory and field training on the living world and its resources.

technical.title: Technical Sciences
technical.description: Engineering and technology programs that combine solid theoretical foundations with hands-on practical work.

mathCs.title: Mathematics and Computer Science
mathCs.description: From algorithms and software engineering to networks and data, preparing graduates for a fast-moving digital world.

law.title: Law and Political Sciences
law.description: Public and private law, institutions and international relations, for careers in justice, administration and diplomacy.

boussouf.label: Our namesake
boussouf.photoLicense: Archive photos and documents are in the public domain; the photo of old Mila is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. All come from Wikimedia Commons: select one to see the original file.
boussouf.sourcesNote: Facts from the encyclopaedia articles above and the works they cite, including Le Monde (3 January 1981) and Mohammed Harbi, “Le Drame algérien” (1995).
boussouf.closing: His name is a promise to every student of this university: that knowledge, organisation and dedication can change the course of a nation.
